spans.s: Jeta-vana, (normally) nt., rarely m. (= Pali id.), n. of the grove at Śrāvastī where Buddha often dwelt and preached: Mv 〔i.4.13〕; 〔27.11〕; 〔29.13〕; 〔30.11〕; 〔31.9〕; 〔32.14〕; 〔33.8〕; 〔73.3〕; 〔iii.224.11〕; Mvy 〔4112〕, ˚nam; LV 〔1.5〕; 〔4.14〕 (here masc., sarvāvantaṃ ˚vanaṃ, acc.); Divy 〔1.2〕 etc.; 〔80.12〕; Av 〔i.13.5〕 etc.; also in vs, the two parts separated, Jetasāhvayaṃ vanaṃ LV 〔7.4〕 (vs), the grove called Jeta.
Jetavanīya, m. pl., n. of a school: Mvy 〔9097〕.
